items.title: How Many Shares of General Mills, Hormel or Kraft Heinz Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes 4,919 shares of General Mills (about $168,200), 7,500 shares of Kraft Heinz (about $181,900) or 10,257 shares of Hormel Foods (about $225,300). Kraft Heinz’s check is the one I’d want, since its dividend takes 50% of its free cash flow, though it paid $1.
